storyCards.headline: Woman: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
John Lennon's "Woman" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Woman" is a song written and performed by English singer John Lennon from his 1980 album Double Fantasy.

The track was chosen by Lennon to be the second single released from the Double Fantasy album, and it was the first Lennon single issued after his murder on 8 December 1980.

The B-side of the single is Yoko Ono's song "Beautiful Boys".

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #2 on the Hot 100.
